body.condition:
The set \(\mathcal X\) is nonempty and finite, \(I\) is a nondegenerate compact interval contained in \(\operatorname{int}(\mathcal A)\), and the fixed indices satisfy
\[
 B_A>0,\quad \beta>\frac12,\quad q_e>1,\quad
 M_e>0,\quad R_q>0,\quad B_Y\ge1,
\]
and
\[
 0<p_{\min}\le |\mathcal X|^{-1},\quad
 R_f\ge R_{f,0},\quad 0<\kappa\le\kappa_0.
\]

novel.justification: novel: This fixed-index compatibility condition is exactly what makes the declared quantitative class contain the explicit reference law; it adds no estimator-side requirement.
